**Director \- Product Management (Operations)**

### **Location**: Hyderabad, India
**Employment Type:** Full\-Time; Salaried
**Compensation:** Base Salary, Bonus, Medical

Job Description
===============

### **About Us**


Innovapptive is a **category\-defining SaaS company** building the world’s most advanced **AI\-powered Connected Worker Platform** for the industrial sector. Headquartered in Houston, TX, and backed by **Vista Equity Partners**, Innovapptive is on a mission to **reimagine how industrial work gets done** — connecting frontline workers, back\-office systems, and assets in real time to drive higher safety, reliability, and productivity.


Our platform is trusted by some of the world’s largest enterprises — including **Shell, Hess, Cenovus Energy, W.R.Grace, Westlake Chemicals, UNICEF, Kimberly Clark, Scott Miracle Gro, and Newmont Mining** to name a few, and across chemicals, energy, mining, and manufacturing industries. These enterprises have achieved tangible, hard\-dollar results, such as:

* Over **$40 million in annual EBITDA savings** at a single enterprise.
* **10× frontline productivity improvements** through mobile\-first and AI\-enabled workflows.
* **15–20% maintenance cost reductions** and **significant uptime gains** across plants and sites.


Innovapptive is recognized by leading industry analysts for its differentiated value creation model:

* Named a **Leader in the Frost \& Sullivan Industrial Connected Worker Radar.**
* Featured by **Gartner** in “Connected Factory Worker” research and the **Hype Cycle for Manufacturing Operations Strategy.**
* Cited by **LNS Research** for delivering **3–5× greater value** than point solutions through unified OT–IT execution, AI/vision innovation, and field\-proven ROI.


Our growth is backed by **Tiger Global Management and Vista Equity Partners**, one of the world’s premier software investors, known for scaling high\-performance SaaS companies. Together, we are building the next\-generation AI Powered Connected Worker Platform, combining cutting\-edge technologies — SLM’s, Generative AI, Computer Vision, and Intelligent Orchestration — into a unified system that transforms plant operations globally.


Today, with over **300\+ employees across the U.S., India, and ANZ**, Innovapptive stands at a pivotal inflection point: with an ambition to scale to **$100M ARR within the next 3\-4 years** by industrializing every aspect of our product, engineering, and customer delivery systems.

### **The Opportunity**


The Director – Product Management (Operations) will own and scale Innovapptive’s Operations product suite, driving innovation, frontline productivity, operational excellence, and measurable business outcomes for enterprise customers in asset\-intensive and manufacturing industries. This role combines strategic product leadership with hands\-on execution across discovery, delivery, GTM, and stakeholder management.

* Lead the product strategy and roadmap for an operations / production\-focused product suite, ensuring scalability, usability, and measurable impact on frontline productivity and business KPIs.
* Drive the full product lifecycle: customer discovery, requirement definition, prioritization, execution with engineering, and post\-launch adoption and continuous improvement.
* Collaborate closely with customers, Sales, Customer Success, and Implementation teams to identify operational challenges, validate solutions, and translate complex manufacturing and production workflows into intuitive product experiences.
* Define and track product success metrics, leveraging data and analytics to drive decisions on feature enhancements, prioritization, and long\-term product investments.
* Drive product initiatives focused on production efficiency, OEE (Overall Equipment Effectiveness), operational excellence, continuous improvement, and frontline productivity.
* Partner with GTM teams on positioning, pricing, packaging, demos, proposals, and enablement for enterprise customers across manufacturing and industrial operations.
* Mentor and lead Product Managers, fostering a culture of ownership, experimentation, customer focus, and cross\-functional collaboration.
* Prepare and present business cases, product proposals, roadmap updates, and product performance to senior leadership and key stakeholders.
* Ensure alignment with agile delivery practices and contribute to continuous improvement of product processes and rituals.

**What You Bring to the Team:**

* 10\+ years of Product Management experience, with at least 2–3 years in a Director, Senior Product Manager, Head of Product, or equivalent leadership role, owning a product or portfolio.
* Strong experience building and scaling B2B SaaS products, preferably Enterprise SaaS, with experience owning product strategy, roadmap, and end\-to\-end product lifecycle.
* Prior experience working closely with operations, manufacturing, production, plant, or frontline teams, with a strong understanding of operational workflows and business challenges.
* Strong domain exposure to OEE, Production, Continuous Improvement, Operational Excellence, Manufacturing Operations, or similar industrial workflows.
* Experience with MES (Manufacturing Execution Systems), Connected Worker, Industrial IoT/IIoT, Smart Manufacturing, or digital manufacturing platforms is highly preferred.
* Proven track record of managing end\-to\-end product lifecycle and shipping impactful products/features in close partnership with engineering, design, sales, and business stakeholders.
* Experience leading high\-performing product teams and influencing cross\-functional stakeholders without authority.

jobs.title: Sales Analyst
jobs.description:
Azurity Pharmaceuticals is a privately held, specialty pharmaceutical company that focuses on innovative products that meet the needs of underserved patients. As an industry leader in providing unique, accessible, and high\-quality medications, Azurity leverages its integrated capabilities and vast partner network to continually expand its broad commercial product portfolio and robust late\-stage pipeline. The company's patient\-centric products span the cardiovascular, neurology, endocrinology, gastro\-intestinal, institutional, and orphan markets, and have benefited millions of patients. For more information, visit www.azurity.com.



Azurity Pharmaceuticals is proud to be an inclusive workplace and an Equal Opportunity Employer. Azurity's success is attributable to our incredibly talented, dedicated team that focuses on benefiting the lives of patients by bringing the best science and commitment to quality into everything that we do. We seek highly motivated individuals with the dedication, integrity, and creative spirit needed to thrive in our organization.


**About the Role**

The Sales Analyst is the operational and analytical backbone of the sales organization. The role owns the integrity of the lead and account data that the sales team runs on — reconciling leads from multiple sources, keeping the CRM accurate, ensuring accounts are allocated correctly across the sales team, and turning activity data into insight through tracking, analysis and dashboards. This is a hands\-on role for someone who is comfortable working with messy data across systems, has strong judgement about what "clean" looks like, and can use Python, Advanced Excel and AI tools such as Claude to move faster than a manual process would allow


**Key Responsibilities**

**1\. Lead Management and Reconciliation**

* Consolidate and reconcile leads across the existing lead base and all new inbound and outbound sources, including membership rosters, conference and event lists, marketing campaigns, referrals and partner or purchased lists.
* Identify and resolve duplicates, near\-matches and conflicting records across sources; establish a single, trusted view of each lead and account.
* Standardise lead data (company name, domain, industry, geography, contact details, source attribution) so records are usable for segmentation and reporting. Incorporate lead qualifiers to improve sales strategy.
* Maintain a clear audit trail of what came in, from where, when, and how it was resolved. • Flag data\-quality issues at source and work with marketing, events and membership teams to fix them upstream.


**2\. CRM Ownership and Account Allocation**

* Keep the CRM current and accurate for leads, contacts, accounts and opportunities; own bulk uploads, enrichment and clean\-up.
* Allocate accounts and leads across the sales team in line with the coverage model and territory or segment rules agreed with sales leadership.
* Track allocation coverage — identify unassigned, over\-concentrated or stale accounts and escalate for re\-allocation.
* Implement changes to ownership, territories and segmentation promptly and communicate them to affected sales team members.
* Maintain CRM hygiene standards, documentation and light process and field governance; train and support the sales team on correct usage.


**3\. Sales Activity Tracking and Analysis**

* Track leading indicators of sales performance — calls, meetings, discussions, follow\-ups, pipeline creation and conversion at each stage.
* Produce regular analysis on activity volumes, conversion rates, cycle times, source effectiveness and pipeline health, by representative, segment, region and lead source.
* Report on closed sales against targets and connect outcomes back to the activity and lead sources that generated them.
* Surface trends, bottlenecks and outliers proactively rather than only on request; provide the commentary that explains why the numbers moved, not just what they are.
* Support sales leadership with ad\-hoc analysis for pipeline reviews, forecasting discussions and planning cycles.


**4\. Dashboards and Reporting Infrastructure**

* Build and maintain dashboards that give sales leaders and representatives a live view of leads, activity, pipeline and performance against target.
* Automate recurring reporting so that manual effort is minimised and refresh cycles are reliable.
* Design reporting that is genuinely used — clear definitions, consistent metrics, and views tailored to each audience (representative, manager, leadership).
* Own the documentation of metric definitions and data sources so numbers are consistent across the organisation. 5\. Cross\-Functional Working
* Work closely with other functional teams as required — marketing, membership, events, finance, product and IT — to source data, resolve issues and support shared initiatives.
* Act as the point of contact for sales data requests from other functions, and ensure the numbers shared outside the team are consistent with internal reporting. Contribute to cross\-functional projects such as system migrations, campaign planning, event follow\-up and annual planning cycles.


**Required Skills and Experience**

**Technical**

* Python — data cleaning, deduplication, fuzzy and entity matching, joining data across sources, and automation of recurring tasks (pandas and similar libraries).
* Advanced Excel — complex formulas, lookups, Power Query, pivot tables, modelling and large\-file handling.
* AI tools — practical working experience with Claude or comparable AI agents and assistants to accelerate analysis, data preparation, reconciliation logic, documentation and reporting workflows.
* CRM — hands\-on experience administering or operating in a CRM (Salesforce, HubSpot, Zoho, Dynamics or similar), including imports, field management and reporting.
* Dashboarding — experience building dashboards in a BI tool (Power BI, Tableau, Looker) or native CRM reporting.

jobs.title: FBS Product Owner III- Guidewire
jobs.description:
Takes a fully independent lead in several areas of product development by following the principles of Agile to manage the team backlog, anticipate and prioritize needs, oversee development stages, act as a primary liaison and evaluate product progress. Serves as the customer proxy; works collaboratively with business owners and other stakeholders to accomplish these tasks with little to no support with a high volume of work and increased complexity. Utilizes strong understanding of the business vision to to regularly contribute and manage execution. Heavily influences the business owner's requirements, the Product Manager's program vision and roadmap while introducing new and useful tools and practices to drive continuous improvement. Provides overall leadership to Product Owner team through mentorship and guidance and provides back up to Product Manager, as needed.

 **Requirements**  

Applies basic scientific practice within iterations in order to routinely plan, do, check and adjust. Manages team backlog items and prioritizes based on business value. Outlines dependencies and informs stakeholders the necessary sequence of development to ensure optimized performance and outcomes. Holds a significant role in quality control and is the primary team member empowered to accept stories as done. Utilizes advanced business knowledge, based on prior experience within business function, and communication skills to anticipate problems and address them accordingly. Works cross functionally in a self\-organizing manner to accomplish tasks and effectively manage the backlog. Leads processes and procedure changes identified by teams by working with external business partners. Effectively applies critical thinking to identify flexibility in determining how and when each iteration and product element will be developed. Acts as primary communicator and connection between stakeholders, end users and teams determining if each story meets their shared e xpectations. Ensures collaboration from all stakeholders on decisions and strategy providing clear instructions and deliverables for developers. Takes ownership for each stage of the process and final product to ensure the goal and vision are correctly aligned with the work items on the backlog. Contributes strategic input into the prioritization of the program backlog, coordinates dependencies and manages the inspection and evaluation of product progress through each iteration. Drives the mitigation of program risks. Leads PO and/or ART sync meetings in addition to the system demo to show critical aspects of the solution. Leads in Inspect \& Adapt (I\&A) workshop to work across teams to define and implement improvement stories to increase program quality. A key member of the Agile team who utilizes perspective to define iteration goals and drives execution and delivery. Partners with the business owner to understand needs, manage scope and add/eliminate user stories while contributing heavy influence to build an effective strategy. Communicates requirements to Agile Team in a clear and collaborative manner to determine new requirements, negotiate teams and dependencies. Regularly interacts closely with the Product Manager in order to discuss goals and vision of the business/value stream, sharing extensive knowledge in order to make sound decisions. Heavily involved in the Program Increment (PI) planning, story definition and assists team with story estimates and sequencing. Oversees the development of the product to include planning, refinement, review, and execution. Partners with stakeholders to identify and organize steps required for next iteration. Works to gain clarity on queries and participate in the demo of committed items. Participates in ceremonies within the team to coordinate efforts with team to refine the process, identify areas for improvement and support the execution of tasks. Continuously keeps the end\-user needs in mind based on higher level of business acumen to ensure the solution meets expectations and the development delivers expected outcomes from the accepted stories. Independently represents business owners' interest and prioritize user stories based on business value while maximizing agile team's capacity. Provides mentorship and guidance to PO I and II. Performs other duties as assigned.

 **Benefits**  

Competitive compensation and benefits package:

* Competitive salary and performance\-based bonuses
* Comprehensive benefits package
* Career development and training opportunities
* Flexible work arrangements (remote and/or office\-based)
* Dynamic and inclusive work culture within a globally renowned group
* Private Health Insurance
* Pension Plan
* Paid Time Off
* Training \& Development

Note: Benefits differ based on employee level.

The Group is guided everyday by its purpose of unleashing human energy through technology for an inclusive and sustainable future. It is a responsible and diverse organization of over 340,000 team members in more than 50 countries. With its strong 55\-year heritage and deep industry expertise, Capgemini is trusted by its clients to address the entire breadth of their business needs, from strategy and design to operations, fueled by the fast evolving and innovative world of cloud, data, AI, connectivity, software, digital engineering and platforms. You will partner with Tech teams to define and design the end\-to\-end experience of associate and frontline leader\-facing tools, including AC3 and Inspire. You will evaluate and improve existing tooling and create new tech and AI driven solutions, consistently enhancing associate experiences and empowering our teams. You will work backward from associate pain points, design products, define product requirements, and partner with engineering, operations, and stakeholder teams to deliver solutions at scale. You will balance short\-term tactical improvements with long\-term strategic bets to continuously raise the bar on the associate experience.
  

The ideal candidate combines strong product and program management capabilities, business acumen in operations and deep associate empathy. You are equally comfortable diving into data and anecdotes to identify opportunities, writing PRFAQs, vision docs and BRDs, and influencing without authority to align cross\-functional teams on a shared vision. This role can be located in Hyderabad.

The Selling Partner Communities (SPC) organization builds lasting connections with and among our Selling Partners, helps drive their success, and ensures that public perception mirrors the reality that Amazon is a great place for our Selling Partners to build and grow thriving businesses. Amazon Seller Forums are used by over one million Selling Partners to connect with each other and Amazon, to get critical information and advice on how to successfully maintain their Amazon Seller business. We are looking for an entrepreneurial Associate Community Manager who wants to play a critical role in shaping our community engagement efforts with Selling Partners across Amazon's Seller Forums and Social Media channels. The ideal candidate has a strong sense of ownership and thrives in an ambiguous environment where they can have a direct impact on the Selling Partner Experience with Amazon. They enjoy building strong internal and external relationships, have excellent communication skills and high judgement. The Seller community landscape is constantly changing and growing \- across both Forums and Social Media. This role requires an individual who can simultaneously dive deep into the day\-to\-day issues of our Selling Partner Community and at the same time think big about emerging community engagement trends and seller experience opportunities.  

The role's key responsibilities will include:  

Gaining a deep understanding of our global Selling community and their needs by building authentic and meaningful relationships with and between Amazon Sellers across Forums and Social Media channels.  

Responding to and resolving Seller cases in Amazon Seller Forums across assigned categories, ensuring timely, high\-quality responses that meet defined SLAs.  

Moderating Social Media channels to triage escalations, and identifying valuable Seller conversations.  

Moderating Seller Forums threads to ensure community guidelines adherence, identifying and escalating policy violations, and managing thread health.  

Partnering with product, customer support, and marketing teams to grow Amazon Seller Community membership and engagement.  

Leading efforts to build and contribute to healthy, 2\-way conversation between Amazon and Sellers via Amazon Forums and Social channels to enlist new and existing sellers into the community.  

Identifying emerging trends in Seller Forums and Social Media, and sharing with internal Amazon teams to ensure we are addressing Seller needs.  

Escalating complex seller issues to partner teams via established processes with clear documentation and follow\-through.  

Promoting a sense of community and inclusion across Selling Partners and team members.

Leveraging metrics, reporting, and Voice of Customer insights to measure the effectiveness of the program and drive improvements to the customer and associate experience.  

  

Key job responsibilities  

This role will interact with Sellers on both Amazon Seller Forums and Social Media. The Community Manager is responsible for timely resolution of seller cases across both channels, maintaining quality standards, and contributing to backlog reduction goals.

**Summary** 




 Cornerstone OnDemand is seeking a Principal Product Manager to lead the delivery of AI\-native products and enterprise outcome agents that drive measurable customer value.

* Partner directly with customers to understand business problems, workflows, pain points, and desired outcomes.
* Translate customer needs into clear product requirements, use cases, and solution concepts that can quickly be tested and refined.
* Build and evolve working prototypes using AI\-native tools such as Lovable, Claude, Co\-Pilot and similar rapid prototyping platforms to accelerate validation and shorten the path from idea to delivery.
* Turn customer specific outcome agents into re\-sellable out\-of\-the box agents
* Use prototypes as the new PRD motion: move from customer discovery to working AI Agent prototypes that customers, FDE’s and engineering can review, test, and refine.
* Collaborate closely with FDEs and engineering to iterate on prototypes, validate feasibility, refine user flows, and prepare solutions for launch.
* Work with customers, FDEs and engineering in tight feedback loops to improve prototypes, confirm value, and shape deliverable product capabilities.
* Drive cross\-functional execution across product, engineering, design, data science, architecture, and go\-to\-market teams to bring validated concepts into production.
* Ensure launched outcome agents are practical, scalable, and easy for enterprise customers to adopt.
* Use customer feedback, adoption signals, and business\-impact metrics to continuously improve product execution and outcomes.



  





**You Have Got What it Takes if you Have** 



* 5\+ years of experience in product management, including significant experience delivering enterprise software, SaaS, AI, or platform products.
* Strong track record in customer\-facing product delivery for enterprise SaaS or AI\-native products.
* Demonstrated ability to go from customer discovery and requirements to working prototypes and launched solutions.
* Hands\-on experience using AI\-native prototyping and product development tools such as Lovable, Claude, Co\-Pilot or similar tools to accelerate product definition and validation.
* Experience collaborating closely with customers and technical delivery partners such as FDEs to iterate rapidly and launch customer\-ready solutions.
* Strong product execution skills, including prioritization, prototype validation, release planning, cross\-functional coordination, and delivery tracking.
* Experience translating ambiguous customer problems into structured product requirements and testable product experiences.
* Strong analytical, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
* Ability to operate effectively in fast\-moving, matrixed environments and drive alignment across technical and business teams.



  





**Preferred Qualifications** 



* Experience delivering AI agents, copilots, workflow agents, or decision\-support products.
* Experience in enterprise AI, workforce technology, learning, talent, HR technology, or related SaaS domains.
* Demonstrated success using rapid prototyping to accelerate product\-market fit and customer adoption.
* Experience working in close partnership with customer success, services, sales, and solution delivery teams.

Part of GCBP (Google Cloud Business Platform), we are modernizing the Quote\-to\-Cash life\-cycle—from ordering and provisioning to billing—ensuring data quality across Cloud's financial, sales compensation, and transaction systems. We offer a collaborative, culture focused on major architectural upgrades and high\-stakes initiatives.

We provide growth opportunities, empowering Product Managers to direct high\-visibility programs and strategic integrations alongside talented peers. We deliver enterprise\-grade solutions that leverage Google’s cutting\-edge technology, and tools that help developers build more sustainably. Customers in more than 200 countries and territories turn to Google Cloud as their trusted partner to enable growth and solve their most critical business problems.

jobs.description:
**Company Description**
 Wise is a global technology company, building the best way to move and manage the world’s money.
   

  

**Min fees. Max ease. Full speed.**
 Whether people and businesses are sending money to another country, spending abroad, or making and receiving international payments, Wise is on a mission to make their lives easier and save them money.
   

  

 As part of our team, you will be helping us create an entirely new network for the world's money.
   

  

**For everyone, everywhere.**
**Job Description**
 More about
 **our mission** 
 and
 **what we offer** 
 .
   

  

**About Wise**
 Wise is building money without borders. Our customers should be able to move, hold, receive, and spend money internationally with a product that is fast, transparent, low\-cost, and safe.
   

  

 Verification is central to that mission. We need to keep financial crime out of Wise, meet regulatory obligations across many markets, and make it easy for legitimate customers to get started and use our products.
   

  

**About The Team**
 The Global KYC and Onboarding Squad is improving Wise's KYC and onboarding experience by reducing three things at the same time:
   

  

* Financial crime risk, by making reviews, controls, and decisioning more effective.
* Operational cost, by automating repeatable work and improving how agents handle complex cases.
* Customer friction, by making verification clearer, faster, and easier to complete.


 Business Onboarding Verification focuses on business customers. Businesses are not simple identity objects: they are legal entities connected to directors, shareholders, UBOs, authorised signatories, employees, documents, registry data, vendor data, ownership structures, risk signals, and market\-specific requirements.
   

  

 That makes KYB one of Wise's most complex verification domains. It is also one of the biggest opportunities to improve customer experience, reduce manual work, improve control quality, and build better risk decisioning.
   

  

**About The Role**
 We are hiring a Product Manager to own one of the workstreams within Business Onboarding Verification. Each PM within the team owns a complex product area end to end, from discovery and roadmap through delivery, measurement, and iteration.
   

  

 These are not generic AI, programme management, or stakeholder coordination roles. You will coordinate complex work, but the core of the job is product ownership: defining the problem, shaping the solution, making trade\-offs explicit, setting success metrics, launching safely, and ensuring each change improves KYB as a product.
   

  

**What You Will Own**
* Own the product roadmap for one BOV workstream, from discovery through launch and iteration.
* Identify the highest\-value problems using customer friction, operational cost, manual review load, risk impact, regulatory need, and delivery readiness.
* Translate ambiguous KYB problems into clear product requirements, launch criteria, success metrics, and learning loops.
* Partner with Engineering, Analytics/Data Science, Product Compliance, Risk, Operations, regional teams, vendors, support partners, and adjacent PMs.
* Define launch metrics and guardrails across customer impact, manual review load, operational adoption, control quality, false positives, false negatives, auditability, monitoring, and rollback.
* Build feedback loops from agents, QA, assurance, customer outcomes, support contacts, downstream risk signals, and vendor/model performance where relevant.
* Balance tactical delivery with long\-term product foundations.


**What Success Looks Like In The First 6\-12 Months**
* Your workstream has a clear roadmap with explicit priorities and measurable outcomes.
* The team has shipped meaningful product improvements, not just analysis or coordination.
* Product changes are safer to launch because metrics, guardrails, monitoring, fallback paths, and ownership are clear.
* Cross\-functional partners understand what is being solved, why it matters, who owns what, and how success will be measured.
* KYB becomes faster, more measurable, more auditable, and easier for legitimate businesses and agents to navigate.


**This Role Gives You The Opportunity To**
* Work on one of the most important regulated onboarding domains at Wise.
* Improve the experience for business customers and the agents reviewing their cases.
* Build practical AI, automation, decisioning, controls, and platform foundations in a real operational environment.
* Work across Product, Engineering, Compliance, Risk, Operations, Analytics, regional teams, and vendors on high\-stakes problems.
* Shape how Wise moves from fragmented manual review and tactical control work toward reusable, measurable KYB capabilities.


**Qualifications**
**What We Are Looking For**
* You have product management experience owning complex work from discovery through delivery and measurable outcomes.
* You are comfortable in data\-heavy, risk\-sensitive, operational, regulated, onboarding, payments, trust and safety, compliance, or fintech domains.
* You can reason with data and metrics, including denominators, baselines, segmentation, sample bias, data quality, attribution limits, and guardrails.
* You can translate ambiguous product, risk, compliance, or operational problems into clear requirements, launch criteria, and iteration plans.
* You understand that regulated product delivery needs evidence, auditability, operational readiness, monitoring, and ownership.
* You communicate clearly, make trade\-offs explicit, and can create alignment without formal authority.


**Strong Additional Signals**
* Experience in KYB, KYC, business onboarding, financial crime, identity, fraud, risk decisioning, compliance tooling, operational tooling, payments, or regulated fintech.
* Experience with AI, LLMs, ML models, document intelligence, decisioning systems, vendor evaluation, or agent\-assist tooling.
* Experience turning remediation, audit,…

* Collaborate closely with Engineering, QA, UX, Data, Architecture, and Operations teams to groom features, clarify requirements, resolve dependencies, and support timely delivery.
* Translate business objectives and complex financial\-market requirements into epics, features, user stories, process flows, business rules, and acceptance criteria.
* Lead backlog refinement, sprint planning, story elaboration, sprint reviews, product demonstrations, and stakeholder feedback sessions.
* Ensure user stories are ready for development by defining functional behavior, data attributes, validation rules, exception handling, dependencies, and testable acceptance criteria.
* Make day\-to\-day prioritization decisions by balancing customer value, market needs, regulatory requirements, operational risk, technical dependencies, delivery capacity, and time\-to\-market considerations.
* Serve as the primary business and functional point of contact for the Scrum team, providing timely clarification and decisions throughout the development lifecycle.
* Partner with stakeholders to validate delivered functionality, incorporate feedback, and confirm release readiness.
* Identify and manage product, data, process, and dependency risks; drive appropriate resolution and escalation.
* Support release planning, stakeholder communications, product documentation, training, and change\-management activities.
* Define and monitor product success measures, including adoption, data quality, user satisfaction, delivery predictability, operational efficiency, and realized business value.
* Champion continuous improvement in product discovery, backlog quality, Agile practices, delivery processes, and stakeholder collaboration.


**Required Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Business, Technology, Economics, or a related discipline; equivalent relevant experience of 7 to 12 years will be considered.
* Demonstrated experience as a Product Owner, Business Analyst, Product Manager, or similar role supporting financial technology, market data, investment\-management, or enterprise financial products.
* Prior experience in the financial technology sector, with a strong understanding of financial\-services workflows, data usage, and client needs.
* Strong domain knowledge of financial markets, investment products, and reference data, including instrument, issuer, entity, pricing, corporate actions, classifications, identifiers, symbology, and security hierarchies.
* Working knowledge of financial data from major industry vendors, including Bloomberg, LSEG Data \& Analytics (formerly Refinitiv), S\&P Global Market Intelligence/Markit, FactSet, and ICE Data Services.
* Strong understanding of multiple asset classes, including Equities, Fixed Income, listed and over\-the\-counter Derivatives, Credit Default Swaps, Credit Indices, Total Return Swaps, and other investment products.
* Knowledge of reference\-data sourcing, vendor data mapping, normalization, enrichment, data lineage, reconciliation, golden\-source practices, and data\-quality controls.
* Ability to understand financial instrument lifecycles and the downstream impact of data changes across trading, risk, operations, reporting, compliance, and client\-facing workflows.
* Demonstrated experience working in Agile delivery environments, including Scrum ceremonies, backlog refinement, sprint planning, sprint reviews, retrospectives, and release planning.
* Hands\-on experience using Jira to create and manage epics, features, user stories, defects, workflows, dashboards, reports, and product backlogs.
* Ability to write clear, concise, and unambiguous user stories with detailed, testable acceptance criteria.
* Experience collaborating with technical teams and working knowledge of software\-delivery concepts, including APIs, data integrations, system dependencies, testing, and production releases.
* Excellent stakeholder\-management, communication, facilitation, analytical, problem\-solving, and decision\-making skills.
* Ability to manage ambiguity, build alignment across cross\-functional stakeholders, and maintain focus on delivering measurable customer and business value.


 We are dedicated to fostering a collaborative, engaging, and inclusive environment and are committed to providing a workplace that empowers associates to be authentic and bring their best to work. We believe that associates do their best when they feel safe, understood, and valued, and we work diligently and collaboratively to ensure Broadridge is a company—and ultimately a community—that recognizes and celebrates everyone’s unique perspective.
   

  

**Use of AI in Hiring**
 As part of the recruiting process, Broadridge may use technology, including artificial intelligence (AI)\-based tools, to help review and evaluate applications. These tools are used only to support our recruiters and hiring managers, and all employment decisions include human review to ensure fairness, accuracy, and compliance with applicable laws. Please note that honesty and transparency are critical to our hiring process. Any attempt to falsify, misrepresent, or disguise information in an application, resume, assessment, or interview will result in disqualification from consideration.

jobs.description:
**About the Role:** 




  





 We are seeking an experienced and technically adept Product Owner (TPO) to join our expanding Product Management team. This is a critical role in the agile delivery of complex, enterprise\-grade compliance solutions. You will act as the bridge between business, design, and engineering \- owning the product backlog and driving the delivery of features that align with business outcomes and user needs. You will be involved in everything from requirements gathering and story writing to solution design and customer documentation.
 



  





**Job requirements:** 




  




* 8\-12 years of experience in Product Management or Product Owner roles in large global, multinational SaaS or enterprise environments.
* Proven success delivering products built on Java, data\-driven architectures, and APIs.
* Experience delivering or supporting AI/ML\-powered features, such as intelligent alerts, predictive analytics, or NLP\-driven workflows.
* Strong understanding of AI\-enhanced user experiences, and ability to write product requirements that align AI capabilities with business value.
* Demonstrated success working in product\-driven SaaS environments.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills across technical and business audiences.
* Proficient in writing clear, testable user stories, functional and non\-functional requirements, and acceptance criteria.
* Skilled in wireframing, data modeling (ERDs), SQL, and API integration.
* Strong problem\-solving ability with attention to detail and a proactive mindset.
* Effective in both independent work and cross\-functional collaboration within fast\-paced, agile environments.
* Proficient in Agile methodologies and project management practices.
* Hands\-on experience with JIRA, Confluence, or similar tools for backlog and documentation management.
* Strong analytical skills for feature validation, requirement refinement, and product performance assessment.
* Deep client insight and ability to align user needs with business goals.
* Experienced in collaborating with Architects/Tech Leads to design scalable solutions and challenge assumptions constructively.
* Skilled in negotiating trade\-offs between scope, resources, and impact to align with product roadmaps.
* Contributes to strategic planning and long\-term roadmap development.
* Adaptable and comfortable working in fast\-paced, evolving environments.
* Able to operate in globally distributed teams across time zones and cultural contexts.
* UX sensibility and ability to partner with designers to shape intuitive user journeys and product experiences.
* Disciplined in backlog grooming, release planning, and sprint execution with agile teams.
* Awareness of change management practices and ability to support internal enablement and customer adoption.



  





**Qualifications:** 



* Domain knowledge in Capital Markets, Trade Surveillance, Anti\-Money Laundering, or Data Analytics tools.
* Familiarity with AI product lifecycle, including model validation, user feedback loops, and ethical implications.
* Exposure to tools like OpenAI, Hugging Face, or Azure ML from a product integration perspective.
* Demonstrated leadership in innovation initiatives, such as generative AI prototypes, automation pilots, or internal product accelerators.
* Familiarity with event\-driven architecture and microservices in SaaS ecosystems.
* Experience using product analytics tools (e.g., Amplitude, Mixpanel, GA4\) for KPI tracking and iteration planning.
* Knowledge of privacy and compliance frameworks (e.g., GDPR, SOC 2\) and their implications on product decisions.
* Familiarity with BDD practices, including Gherkin\-style acceptance criteria.
* Understanding of CI/CD and DevOps environments and their influence on delivery pipelines.
* Comfortable managing vendor integrations, particularly in regulated domains.
* Certified Scrum Product Owner (CSPO) or equivalent certification is a plus.



  





**Key Responsibilities** 



* Backlog Ownership: Manage the product backlog for one or more functional areas, ensuring prioritization aligns with strategic goals.
* Requirements Gathering: Collaborate with stakeholders across business units to define and document both functional and non\-functional requirements.
* User Story Development: Translate requirements into detailed user stories with clear, testable acceptance criteria suitable for 2\-week sprint delivery.
* Design Validation: Work closely with the Design team to ensure stories meet user expectations and support intuitive user experiences.
* Technical Collaboration: Participate in grooming sessions and support task breakdowns and estimations with engineering.
* Solution Prototyping: Contribute to the ideation and prototyping of new features and enhancements.
* Release Communication: Own the creation of release notes and other external documentation for customer\-facing product updates.
* Cross\-Functional Liaison: Serve as the primary interface between Product Management, Engineering, and Design to drive alignment and execution.

jobs.description:
At PDI Technologies, we empower some of the world's leading convenience retail and petroleum brands with cutting\-edge technology solutions that drive growth and operational efficiency.
 


  


 By “Connecting Convenience” across the globe, we empower businesses to increase productivity, make more informed decisions, and engage faster with customers through loyalty programs, shopper insights, and unmatched real\-time market intelligence via mobile applications, such as GasBuddy.  We’re a global team committed to excellence, collaboration, and driving real impact. Explore our opportunities and become part of a company that values diversity, integrity, and growth.
 


  






  




**Role Overview:** 
  


 PDI Technologies is looking for a Product Owner to help manage multiple simultaneous projects and issues of varying size, end to end, within our Loyalty engine ecosystem. The Product Owner (PO) is a critical member of an Agile development team that drives the team to deliver high\-quality, high\-value features and functions in service of our Loyalty business.
 


  


 As a PO, you will help shape product features and requirements while working closely with Agile engineering teams, Product Managers, customers, and business stakeholders to build high\-quality products for our target markets. Prior experience in Product Management, Product Owner, or Business Analyst roles — ideally with exposure to loyalty, rewards, or CRM (Customer Relationship Management) platforms — is highly desired.
 


  


 This role is expected to use AI tools and processes as a core part of how work gets done — accelerating requirements\-gathering, documentation, and story breakdown so the team can move faster without sacrificing quality.
 


  


  




**Key Responsibilities:** 
  

  
* **Stay aligned with and contribute to** 
 the Loyalty product vision, roadmap, and priorities
  
* Work closely with Support to understand and prioritize customer\-reported issues within the Loyalty ecosystem
  
* Work closely with system users (customers, partners, consulting) to understand business needs and translate them into actionable user stories
  
* Apply technical astuteness, attention to detail, and proactivity to drive closure and optimize development team throughput
  
* Use AI\-assisted tools and workflows to speed up requirements analysis, documentation, and backlog preparation
  
* Serve as a product evangelist, particularly with Product Managers and Business teams, helping them understand platform best practices
  
* Develop documentation for new Loyalty features, including UI mockups, process flows, and data sequence diagrams
  
* Attend sprint planning meetings and work with the team to define sprint goals
  
* Guide Agile teams in breaking down user stories and defining acceptance criteria
  
* Ensure the product backlog is prioritized and properly balanced between new product work and maintenance
  
* Collaborate with engineering during sprints to review output and answer questions about desired functionality and outcomes
  
* Ensure the team has an appropriately groomed backlog ready for sprint planning; monitor ready stories vs. velocity
  
* Conduct backlog refinement meetings, sprint reviews, and product demos
  
* Manage the product backlog in ALM tools such as Jira or Azure DevOps
  
* Author and publish product release notes and customer notifications
  
* Own release planning for Loyalty initiatives
  

  


  


  




**Qualifications:** 
  

  
* Ability to connect technical system behavior (rules engines, transaction/redemption flows, integrations) with business goals for the Loyalty program
  
* Comfort working within a complex, rules\-driven engine where changes can have wide\-reaching downstream effects
  
* Experience with loyalty, rewards, promotions, or CRM platforms is a strong plus
  
* Fluent with — or genuinely eager to learn — AI\-assisted product workflows (e.g., using AI tools to accelerate PRD drafting, backlog refinement, research synthesis, and documentation) in order to move quickly in a fast\-paced environment
  
* 2–5 years of experience as a Business Analyst, Product Manager, Product Owner, or similar role, including at least 2 years working as an Agile Product Owner
  
* Highly motivated self\-starter with a desire to help others, take action, and seek out resources to excel within the role
  
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to translate technical concepts into non\-technical terms and vice versa
  
* Ability to work independently as a contributing member of a high\-paced, focused team, managing multiple priorities and competing deadlines
  
* Strong problem\-solving and analytical skills, with the ability to work under pressure
  
* Ability to socialize ideas and influence decisions without direct authority
  
* Collaborative by nature, with a strong desire to dig in and learn independently and through asking questions
  
* Comfortable partnering with and reporting to leadership based in the U.S., with strong cross\-time\-zone communication habits

jobs.title: Product Owner
jobs.description:
**About StarRez**
 StarRez is the global leader in student housing software, providing innovative solutions for on and off\-campus housing management, resident wellness and experience, and revenue generation. Trusted by 1,400\+ clients across 25\+ countries, StarRez supports more than 4 million beds annually with its user\-friendly, all\-in\-one platform, delivering seamless experiences for students and administrators. With offices in the United States, Australia, the UK, and India, StarRez blends the robust capabilities of a global organization with the personalized care and service of a trusted partner.
   

  

**About The Role**
 As a Product Owner, you will be responsible for the end\-to\-end delivery of product workstreams, acting as the bridge between Product Managers and the development teams. While the Product Manager focuses more on leading the relevant product vision and strategy and generating impactful roadmaps, your role will be to ensure flawless execution of that body of work in conjunction with your Product Engineering team. That includes owning requirements and Acceptance Criteria, grooming the backlog and helping deliver quality software to market.
   

  

 Additionally, you will own and lead well defined projects, as agreed with the Product Manager, to deliver incremental value toward the Product and Technology department's goals. Ultimately, the Product Manager and the Product Owner collaborate to deliver world class outcomes for our business.
   

  

**What You Will Own**
**Backlog Management \& Prioritization**
* Own and manage the product backlog for your assigned product or workstream.
* Collaborate with the Product Manager to understand product goals and ensure backlog prioritization aligns with strategic objectives.
* Clearly define user stories, acceptance criteria, and technical requirements in collaboration with the engineering and design teams.


**Delivery Execution**
* Maintain alignment with the product roadmap, ensuring backlog items are prioritized and executed in line with roadmap goals.
* Identify and independently own well defined initiatives, as agreed with the Product Manager, ensuring successful delivery of these workstreams.


**Stakeholder Collaboration**
* Coordinate with Product Managers to gather business requirements and translate them into actionable tasks.
* Collaborate closely with the Product Manager to ensure all executed work aligns with the product vision and strategic outcomes for the area.
* Actively engage with cross\-functional teams, including Engineering, Design, Quality, and Customer Success.


**Refinement \& Continuous Improvement**
* Assist backlog refinement sessions, sprint planning, and retrospectives, continuously improving processes and team effectiveness.
* Support all relevant agile processes that the team follows, ensuring high levels of collaboration and accountability.
* Analyze and incorporate feedback from users, Quality, and internal stakeholders to refine features and improve outcomes.


**Product Quality \& Value Delivery**
* Collaborate to ensure the delivered product increments meet quality standards and deliver value to users.
* Track and report on key delivery metrics, identifying areas for improvement and ensuring alignment with product goals.
* Ensure proper documentation of delivered features and support the go\-to market process in collaboration with Product Managers.
* Work with the Product Manager to determine optimizations to live features and incremental work that may further enhance the delivery of outcomes.


**Required Qualification**
* 3\+ years of experience as a Product Owner, or similar role in a SaaS environment.
* Strong understanding of agile product development frameworks, including Scrum or Kanban.
* Proven track record of managing complex product backlogs and delivering high impact features on time.
* Excellent collaboration skills with cross\-functional teams, including engineering, design, and QA.
* Strong communication skills, with the ability to clearly convey requirements and priorities to technical and non\-technical stakeholders.
* Analytical mindset, with the ability to break down complex problems into actionable solutions.
* Experience working closely with Product Managers to translate strategic goals into deliverable tasks.
* Familiarity with product management and development tools (e.g., Jira, Confluence, Miro etc)


**Preferred Qualification**
* Experience working in B2B SaaS, particularly in Property Tech or Housing.
* Certified Scrum Product Owner (CSPO) or similar agile certification.
* Understanding of user\-centered design principles and product discovery techniques.


**Reasons to Join Our Team**
 StarRez is not just a workplace—it's a place to belong, build, and grow.
   

  

* A Culture That Lasts: Many of our team members have been with us for 20\+ years—a testament to our people\-first philosophy.
* Global Impact, Local Ownership: Join a team that spans across Australia, the USA, the UK, and Canada, working on industry\-leading solutions, while building the centre up from ground up.
* Long\-Term Vision: We're not here for short\-term gains. We invest in our people for the long haul, creating an environment where you can grow, lead, and thrive.
* Innovation with Stability: Backed by Vista Equity Partners, we combine the agility of a scaling SaaS company with the stability of long\-term industry leadership.
* Z\-Factor: We take pride in our culture of passion, care, and high performance. The Z\-Factor defines how we support our teams, foster growth, and ensure that everyone at StarRez thrives.


 StarRez is an equal opportunity employer.

jobs.title: Senior Business Execution Consultant - Employee Data Repository
jobs.description:
**About This Role**
 Wells Fargo is seeking a Senior Business Execution Consultant in the EDR Space
   

  

 The role is responsible for defining, delivering, and continuously enhancing enterprise employee data products and capabilities that support HR, compliance, operational, and regulatory processes. This role partners with business stakeholders, technology teams, vendors, and operations teams to drive product strategy, roadmap execution, data quality, user experience improvements, and operational excellence across EDR platforms and integrations. The role focuses on delivering scalable, secure, and compliant solutions while ensuring employee data is accurate, accessible, and aligned with business objectives.
   

  

**In This Role, You Will**
* Lead support functions or operations for multiple business groups and contribute to large scale strategic initiatives
* Ensure efficiency, quality, cost effectiveness of solutions, and pipeline management relating to assigned operations
* Research moderately complex business, operational, and strategic initiatives that require analytical skills, basic knowledge of organizational strategy and Business Execution, and understanding of international business
* Work independently to make recommendations for support function by providing support and leadership
* Assist in the planning and execution of a variety of programs and initiatives that may include risk mitigation, efficiency, and customer experience
* Collaborate and consult with team leaders in developing project plans, policies and procedures
* Provide leadership in management of relationships and implementation of programs, services, and initiatives with cross functional business partners
* Define and maintain the EDR product vision, strategy, and multi\-year roadmap. Prioritize product initiatives based on business value, regulatory requirements, risk reduction, and operational efficiency. Partner with HR, Technology, Compliance, and Operations stakeholders to align priorities.


**Product Delivery**
 Lead end\-to\-end product delivery from discovery through implementation and post\-production support. Develop business requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, and success metrics. Manage backlog prioritization and release planning in Agile environments. Coordinate testing, production validation, and deployment readiness activities.
   

  

**Data Management \& Integrations**
 Drive improvements to employee data quality, governance, controls, and reporting. Oversee integrations between EDR and upstream/downstream systems. Identify opportunities for automation and process optimization. Support data ingestion, document processing, workflow enhancements, and exception management.
   

  

**Risk, Compliance \& Controls**
 Ensure solutions comply with enterprise data management, privacy, security, and regulatory requirements. Partner with Risk and Control teams to address findings and strengthen controls. Support audit, compliance, and governance activities.
   

  

**Stakeholder Management**
 Serve as the primary liaison between business stakeholders and technology partners. Communicate roadmap status, release plans, risks, dependencies, and outcomes. Drive alignment across cross\-functional teams and executive stakeholders.
   

  

**Operational Excellence**
 Monitor product health, adoption, service levels, and production support metrics. Lead root cause analysis and remediation of critical issues. Establish KPIs and continuously improve product performance and user experience.
   

  

**Required Qualifications**
* 4\+ years of Business Execution, Implementation, or Strategic Planning experience, or equivalent demonstrated through one or a combination of the following: work experience, training, military experience, education
* 4\+ years of Product Management, Product Ownership, Business Analysis, or related experience. Experience managing enterprise data, HR systems, or employee lifecycle platforms. Strong knowledge of Agile delivery methodologies. Experience translating business requirements into technology solutions. Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills. Strong analytical, problem\-solving, and prioritization capabilities.

Have you ever thought about what it takes to detect and prevent unauthorized activity among hundreds of millions of eCommerce transactions across the globe? * 5\+ years of business or financial analysis experience

**About Rippling**
------------------


Rippling gives businesses one place to run HR, IT, and Finance. It brings together all of the workforce systems that are normally scattered across a company, like payroll, expenses, benefits, and computers. For the first time ever, you can manage and automate every part of the employee lifecycle in a single system.

  

Take onboarding, for example. With Rippling, you can hire a new employee anywhere in the world and set up their payroll, corporate card, computer, benefits, and even third\-party apps like Slack and Microsoft 365—all within 90 seconds.

  

Based in San Francisco, CA, Rippling has raised $1\.85B\+ from the world’s top investors—including Kleiner Perkins, Founders Fund, Sequoia, Greenoaks, and Bedrock—and was named one of America's best startup employers by Forbes.

  

We prioritize candidate safety. Please be aware that all official communication will only be sent from @Rippling.com addresses.

 **About the role**


We’re hiring a Product Manager to lead the Payroll Integrations team, which transforms complex payroll activity into accurate accounting data customers can trust. In this role, you’ll define and build the next generation of accounting automations, using AI to build products that generate journal entries, sync payroll data to ERPs, catch errors before they reach the ledger, and help finance teams resolve issues and close their books faster.

  

You’ll own an end\-to\-end product surface with a dedicated engineering team, building for some of Rippling’s largest and most complex payroll customers while partnering closely with customer\-facing teams to translate messy payroll and finance workflows into scalable product experiences.

 **What you will do**

* Set the vision and roadmap for Payroll Integrations, a product area that helps customers turn payroll into accurate financial data they can trust.
* Own the full product experience, from helping customers get set up quickly to making sure data flows reliably into the systems their finance teams depend on.
* Bring AI into real customer workflows so finance teams can catch issues earlier, recover faster, and spend less time on manual follow\-up.
* Partner with engineering, design, and go\-to\-market teams to turn messy operational problems into simple, scalable products.
* Build for some of Rippling’s largest and most complex payroll customers, then generalize those learnings into products that can serve thousands more.

jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


AWS Infrastructure Services (AIS)  

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.  

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.  

  

AIS is seeking a highly motivated and passionate Software Development Engineer who is responsible for designing, developing, testing, and deploying Supply Chain Software and Application. In this role you will collaborate with business leaders, work backwards from customers, identify problems, propose innovative solutions, relentlessly raise standards, and have a positive impact on AWS Infrastructure Supply Chain \& Procurement. In this, you will work closely with a team of Data Engineers and Data Scientists to architect the application programming interface (API) and user Interface (UI) in context with the business outcomes. You will be responsible for the full software development life cycle to build scalable application and deploy in AWS Cloud with high security bar.  

These are all greenfield projects offering a rare opportunity to build systems from the ground up. You will be part of a Supply Chain Automation team within AWS building large scale distributed applications, designing and developing systems from scratch utilizing technologies and frameworks like reactive micro services, serverless computing and distributed NoSQL data stores.  

  

Key job responsibilities  

* Solve complex architecture and business problems to come up with extensible solutions.
* Work with business leaders, Data Engineers, and Data Scientists to ideate business\-friendly software solutions.
* Design client\-side and server\-side architecture for Supply Chain applications.
* Write high quality code that is modular, functional and testable.
* Develop functional databases, applications, and servers to support Supply Chain platforms.
* Write effective APIs and develop technical specifications and documentation.
* Test software to ensure responsiveness and efficiency; troubleshoot, debug and upgrade applications.
* Formally mentor junior engineers on design, coding and troubleshooting.
* Communicate, collaborate and work effectively in a global environment.
**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent
* 5\+ years of non\-internship professional software development experience
* 3\+ years of non\-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
* Experience programming with at least one software programming language

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* 5\+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
* Experience building complex software systems that have been successfully delivered to customers
* Experience communicating with users, other technical teams, and management to collect requirements, describe software product features, and technical designs
* Experience with Supply Chain Planning and Procurement system development is a plus

  

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how\-we\-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

 The Product Manager for AI at GE Vernova plays a crucial role in the development and execution of AI\-powered products that transform business processes. This role is essential to our mission of pioneering AI\-driven innovation and enhancing user experiences across the enterprise.
   

  

 The Product Manager will work with across GE Vernova and with the AI Portfolio Manager to identify, prioritize and build out AI products. These products (several) focus on delivering improvements and value through the lens of the Safety, Quality, Delivery, and Cost (SQDC) framework, measuring the impact of AI initiatives.
   

  

 Additionally, the Product Manager facilitates cross\-business coordination, leveraging AI applications to drive operational improvements and foster innovation across Vernova. Expertise in AI, combined with strong business acumen, is pivotal in translating complex technical challenges into strategic opportunities that propel the organization forward. These duties extend to not only internally developed solutions, but also to external suppliers (e.g. 3rd party software).
   

  

 As a GE Vernova accelerator, GE Vernova Advanced Research is driving strategy and leading research \& development efforts to execute on the business’s mission to help power the energy transition. We forge the collaborations and help invent the technologies required to electrify and decarbonize for a zero\-carbon future.
   

  

 Representing virtually every major scientific and engineering discipline, our researchers are collaborating with GE Vernova’s businesses, the U.S. government, and more than 420 entities at the forefront of technology to execute on 150\+ energy\-focused projects. Collectively, these research programs and initiatives aim to solve near term technical challenges, deliver next generation product advances, and drive long term breakthrough innovation to enable more affordable, reliable, sustainable, and secure energy.
   

  

**Job Description**
 Key Responsibilities:
   

  

* Product Ownership and Development: Collaborate with cross\-functional teams, including business, engineering, and research, to develop and execute product roadmaps that align with strategic objectives.
* Roadmap input: Provide input, alongside the Portfolio manager, to build the product roadmaps
* Technical Collaboration: Work closely with data scientists, IT, and designers to ensure the development of robust AI solutions, maintaining technical rigor and introducing new methods for verifying success and identifying risks.
* User Experience: Focus on delivering exceptional user experiences by understanding and addressing user needs in AI applications.
* Cross\-Business Coordination: Support the coordination of AI applications to drive improvements and innovations across Vernova.
* Data\-Driven Decision Making: Utilize data analytics to measure product performance and make informed decisions. Define and monitor metrics and KPIs to ensure the success and impact of AI initiatives.
* Post\-Launch Support: Monitor product performance post\-launch, gather user feedback, and iterate on product features to enhance value delivery.
* 3rd party solutions: Oversee the interjection of AI products coming from 3rd party software suppliers and determine best technology fit.


**Position Requirements**
* Bachelor's Degree in Mathematics, Computer Science, Engineering, or related field, with 10\+ years of relevant experience.
* Experience with GE/GE Vernova highly preferred.

About Bytebeam
 
 Bytebeam builds the hardware and software that power the next generation of smart connected vehicles. We do device telemetry, remote diagnostics, OTA updates, alerts, and fleet\-scale device management. We help teams ship connected products faster and run them reliably in the field. We are now building an AI\-native platform for Indian commercial fleets. We are building it to be several times better than anything in the market, not a little better.
 


 Role Overview
 
 We are hiring a Product Manager to own products end to end and grow the platform into new categories and new geographies. You are the first point of contact for an idea: you turn it into a sharp product, ship it, and prove it moved the user's outcome.
 



 This is a hands\-on, AI\-first role, and your edge is discovery. In the AI era building is cheap, so finding the right problem is the job. You live in the field, find the real problem, and own it until it is solved and measured, working with engineering, design, data, sales, and support to get there.
 


 What you'll do
 * Own products end to end: Shape a rough idea into a sharp PRD, prioritize hard, ship it, and measure the outcome. Always separate the real need from what people ask for.
* Live in the field: Sit with fleet owners, drivers, and operators where they work, run a customer advisory board, and find the real problem, not the surface one.
* Grow into new markets: Take the product into new customer categories and new geographies, and go get the operators no one serves well today.
* Aim for the multiple: Study the competition, know where we are ahead and behind, and push every feature to be 5x\-10x better, not a little better.
* Set the metric and the guardrail: Give every feature a success metric that proves the promise, and a guardrail for what breaks if it works too well.
* Work AI\-first: Use AI across the whole job (discovery, research, prototyping, PRDs, analysis) to move fast and go deep. Push it hard.


 What we're looking for
 * 3\+ years in product management, ideally B2B software, fleet, logistics, IoT, telematics, automotive, or operations\-heavy products.
* You have owned a product end to end and moved a real metric, from discovery through launch to adoption and revenue.

Shoppers miss applicable savings, struggle to compare cost\-to\-own, and abandon purchases because the "best price" is unclear. jobs.title: Product Manager
jobs.description:
About Aerchain (Why Us?)
 



  





 We’re rewriting the rules of procurement with an AI\-first platform that powers $20B\+ in enterprise spend.
 



  





 From $4M ARR today to $25M ARR and beyond, our mission is to build enterprise\-grade, AI\-first procurement software for global enterprises across manufacturing, FMCG, and services.
 



  





 Role Snapshot
 



  





 You’ll own a cluster of modules and be accountable for the outcomes they drive across customers. You’ll work with enterprise clients to ensure they realise value from the product, lead solutioning for complex accounts, define what the cluster builds and why, and ensure every module delivers measurable customer value. You’ll work across business, engineering, and leadership, and develop the PMs / Builders in your cluster. You set the
 



 standard for how the cluster builds: solutions are prototyped in AI, and engineering builds forward from those prototypes rather than from a blank page. You report to the Product Lead.
 



  





 Role Snapshot
 



  





 You’ll own one or more modules end\-to\-end, not just the backlog, but the customer outcomes those modules drive. You’ll run customer engagements independently, work closely with business and engineering teams, and be the single point of authority for what gets built, deferred, and why. You don’t take requirements; you diagnose problems and prescribe solutions. You don’t just spec the build; you start it: you prototype the solution in AI, and engineering builds forward from what you’ve made rather than from a blank page. You report to a Principal PM / Lead Builder or a Senior PM / Senior Builder.
 



  





 What You’ll Drive
 



  





 Problem Discovery \& Research
 



  




* Own customer engagements end\-to\-end: understand their problems, workflows, and success criteria well enough to prescribe, not just specify.
* Analyse data and signals to validate and size problems. Know the problem better than the customer does.
* Zero escalations without a recommended path and supporting reasoning.



  





 Customer Ownership
 



  




* Own Tier B or Tier C customer engagements end\-to\-end, from understanding their problems to ensuring they realise value from the product.
* Solution customers independently, coordinating with other PMs / Builders where modules overlap.
* Be the single point of contact for your customers, not just during delivery, but through adoption and outcome validation.



  





 Solutioning \& Prototyping
 



  




* Define what gets built, deferred, and killed, with reasoning tied to customer outcomes, not stakeholder volume.
* Write PRDs that engineering can build from without constant clarification: scenarios, edge cases, and acceptance criteria all present before grooming.
* Build working prototypes in AI, not throwaway mockups. Your prototype is the foundation engineering builds forward from: developers extend the backend, harden it, and refine functionality from what you’ve already built. A large part of the build happens in your hands.
* Use AI across every step: research, problem framing, drafting, prototyping, validation.



  





 Execution \& Delivery
 



  




* Own sprint delivery for your modules. Coordinate across engineering and business teams. Unblock issues before they become delays.
* Ensure milestone testing and validation happens before release. Own the quality bar for your modules.



  





 Release \& Adoption
 



  




* Define and track customer\-value metrics for your modules, metrics that answer: is this module making procurement measurably better?
* Own post\-release adoption. A shipped feature with no adoption is a failure you own.



  





 You’ll thrive here if
 



  




* 4–6 years in product roles with demonstrated module or feature ownership.
* You diagnose problems from first principles and prescribe solutions; you don’t take requirements and execute.
* You use AI as a core part of how you work, not occasionally, but across every step of discovery, solutioning, and delivery, including building the prototype engineering carries forward.
* You make decisions in ambiguity with reasoning. You don’t escalate problems, you escalate recommendations.
* You think in outcomes, not outputs. You know the difference between shipping and delivering value.
* Bonus: exposure to enterprise SaaS, complex B2B environments, or procurement tech.



  





 What’s In It For You
 



  




* Full module ownership on a platform that processes $20B\+ in enterprise spend.
* Direct engagement with enterprise customers: you own their outcomes, not just their tickets.
* Work with a team that has chosen to move first on AI: you’ll be operating at a level most product teams won’t reach for years.
* A culture where problem solving, ownership, and action are rewarded, and the opposite is called out.



  





 Ready to build Aerchain’s future?
 



  





 If reimagining business engines with AI and solving problems at scale excites you, let’s talk. Apply now and help us build the most agile enterprise SaaS story in the world.
